articles.title: Chicago White Sox help playoff cause with 3-1 victory
articles.description: Sean Burke allowed one run in six innings, leading the Chicago White Sox to a 3-1 win against the Detroit Tigers on Saturday. The Sox held on to the third AL wild-card spot with the victory.

articles.title: Column: Bullpen implosion leads to epic 11-8 loss, dropping Chicago White Sox out of 1st
articles.description: Chicago White Sox relievers are on a pace to finish with 764 innings, which would rank third in major-league history. Manager Will Venable vowed he won’t change his strategy.

articles.title: Cubs and White Sox are in the hunt for playoff berths: Tracking the magic numbers for Chicago’s baseball teams
articles.description: The marathon that is the Major League Baseball season is down to a September sprint, and the Cubs and White Sox are in the thick of a playoff hunt.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox — 1 strike from victory — lose 7-6 as AL Central lead tightens to a half-game
articles.description: Brayan Rocchio hit a walk-off, two-run double in the ninth to give the Cleveland Guardians a 7-6 win over the Chicago White Sox.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox drop out of 1st in AL Central with 6-3 loss
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox fell into second place in the AL Central with a 6-3 loss to the Cleveland Guardians on Wednesday. With 10 games left, they trail the Guardians by a half-game.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox recall lefty Noah Schultz from Triple-A Charlotte as a multi-inning relief option
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox recalled 2022 first-round draft pick Noah Schultz from Triple-A Charlotte on Tuesday. The Oswego East product could be used in a multi-inning relief role.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox GM Chris Getz foresees changes to the player-evaluation process following scouting shake-up
articles.description: Chicago White Sox GM Chris Getz discussed what’s ahead for the amateur scouting department following director Mike Shirley’s resignation on Saturday.

articles.title: 3 keys for the Chicago White Sox in their playoff push, starting with their sluggers needing to slug
articles.description: Will the sluggers rebound? Can the pitching hold up? How will the club handle the pressure? Those are three keys during the home stretch for the Chicago White Sox.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox beat Detroit Tigers 3-1, move into tie for 1st
articles.description: With nine games left, the Chicago White Sox are tied for first in the AL Central after Munetaka Murakami’s first-inning home run led to a 3-1 win over the Detroit Tigers on Thursday.
